The only no-pin test forces `monkeypatch.setenv("REBAR_GATE_SOURCE", "local")` at test_ref_coherence.py:138 and asserts working-tree stale-code at :149 — i.e. the local degrade path, not the attested current-gate-ref path.

dropped.finding: The amended 'Legacy tolerance' contract — a pre-S4b attestation carrying no `verified_at_sha` pin still verifies under an ATTESTED gate config by comparing its signed hashes against the current-gate-ref basis — has no test. The only no-pin case (`test_local_gate_config_uses_working_tree_basis_on_both_sides`) runs under `source=local`, which takes the working-tree degrade branch, not the attested current-gate-ref branch this contract describes.
scenarios: A pre-S4b (or otherwise unpinned) attestation is claim-gated under the production attested/ref default; a regression that broke the no-pin comparison path would ship undetected.
